title: Concept Bouncer

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines T.10: specify concepts for all template arguments

hints: Number: (std::integral<T> || std::floating_point<T>) && !std::same_as<T, bool>. Surprise: bool IS an integral type, so you must exclude it yourself.
average: sum into a double (not a T: ints would overflow and truncate), divide by size, and return 0.0 for an empty vector.
HasName: requires(const T& t) { { t.name() } -> std::convertible_to<std::string>; } - the arrow checks the RESULT type, so a name() returning int does not count.
describe: an if constexpr chain inside one template works well. Test bool BEFORE std::integral, and use std::convertible_to<const T&, std::string_view> for text.
